title: Tuition instalments
text: Tuition may be paid in full or in two instalments. The first instalment is due by 15 September and the second by 15 February. Late payment incurs a 2% fee per month.

title: Scholarships and discounts
text: Merit scholarships cover 25% to 100% of tuition and are awarded on entrance results. Siblings studying at the same time receive a 10% discount.

title: Refund policy
text: Students who withdraw before the end of the second teaching week receive a full tuition refund minus a 5% administration fee. No refunds are issued after week four.

title: Undergraduate entry requirements
text: Applicants need a completed secondary education certificate, an IELTS score of 5.5 or equivalent, and must pass the university entrance test in mathematics and English.

title: Application deadlines
text: Applications for the autumn intake close on 31 July. Late applications are considered until 20 August if places remain.

title: Residence registration for international students
text: International students must register their place of residence within three working days of arrival. The International Office submits registration on your behalf if you bring your passport and migration card.

title: Student visa invitation letters
text: After accepting an offer, international applicants can request a visa invitation letter from the International Office. Processing takes up to 15 working days.

title: Exam retakes
text: Students who fail a final exam may take one retake during the resit week in the following semester. The maximum mark for a retake is capped at the pass mark.

title: Timetable publication
text: Class timetables are published on the LMS one week before the semester starts. Changes are announced by email and on the LMS dashboard.

title: Grade appeals
text: A student may appeal a final grade within five working days of publication by submitting the appeal form to the programme coordinator.

title: Password reset
text: To reset your university account password, use the Forgot Password link on the login page. If you no longer have access to your recovery email, visit the IT Help Desk with your student ID.

title: Campus Wi-Fi
text: Connect to the campus Wi-Fi network using your university email address and account password. Guest access is available at reception.

title: Library opening hours
text: The library is open from 9:00 to 21:00 on weekdays and from 10:00 to 17:00 on Saturdays. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.
